record.reason: The work shares Transformer weights through recurrence for flow-matching text-to-speech and compares seven depth layouts at a fixed 18 block calls per network evaluation. It is adjacent evidence on compute/parameter tradeoffs in a generative Transformer, but is TTS rather than LLM inference and the fixed call count does not itself demonstrate lower inference compute/latency; retain only as borderline.
record.title: Depth through recurrence: Looped transformers for flow-matching TTS
